scripts.comment:gut-check: READ-ONLY checks only. Consumed by .claude/scripts/gut-check.sh. Never add anything that writes to the tree: build:rust:* and generate:emoji mutate, and so does test:rust-gate:android (it drives a real Gradle build). test:rust-gate:ios became read-only in #813 — it runs every case in a mktemp fake tree — which is why it is in the list below.
scripts.gut-check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run security:invariants && npm run test:rust-gate:ios
scripts.comment:build:rust: #920: there are TWO Rust crates. build:rust:* build BOTH (iOS with a single trailing pod install); build:rust:archive:* build only packages/orbital-archive-reader and are the commands the archive freshness gates name. The signal gates still name build:rust:ios[:release] (a superset) so their message strings and harness cases stay unchanged.
scripts.build:rust:ios: cd packages/orbital-signal && npm run build:ios && cd ../orbital-archive-reader && npm run build:ios && cd ../../ios && pod install
scripts.build:rust:android: cd packages/orbital-signal && npm run build:android && cd ../orbital-archive-reader && npm run build:android
scripts.build:rust: npm run build:rust:ios && npm run build:rust:android
scripts.build:rust:ios:release: cd packages/orbital-signal && npm run build:ios:release && cd ../orbital-archive-reader && npm run build:ios:release && cd ../../ios && pod install
scripts.build:rust:android:release: cd packages/orbital-signal && npm run build:android:release && cd ../orbital-archive-reader && npm run build:android:release
scripts.build:rust:release: npm run build:rust:ios:release && npm run build:rust:android:release
scripts.build:rust:archive:ios: cd packages/orbital-archive-reader && npm run build:ios && cd ../../ios && pod install
scripts.build:rust:archive: npm run build:rust:archive:ios && npm run build:rust:archive:android
scripts.build:rust:archive:ios:release: cd packages/orbital-archive-reader && npm run build:ios:release && cd ../../ios && pod install
scripts.build:rust:archive:release: npm run build:rust:archive:ios:release && npm run build:rust:archive:android:release
